brief.headline: Binance suffers record $6.3 billion crypto theft
brief.detail: Binance says a security breach affected about $6.3 billion in assets, the largest crypto theft on record, and roughly $3 billion has been frozen.

brief.headline: Nasdaq 100 heads for third correction this year
brief.detail: Investors dumped big tech stocks after a slew of disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 on course for its third technical correction of 2026.

brief.headline: Anthropic publicly files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO
brief.detail: Anthropic has made its S-1 filing public for a proposed Nasdaq initial public offering.

brief.headline: Reddit shares plunge 30% on weak outlook
brief.detail: Reddit shares sank after weak Q4 sales guidance and a plan to test requiring users to log in to see content.

brief.headline: Intel stock crashes, cutting $12 billion from government stake
brief.detail: Intel is suffering as PC sales weaken, with AI demand for memory and other components pushing PC prices higher.
